outputs.headline: SCAM: PM Modi is not giving free mobile recharge
outputs.summary: The claim that Prime Minister Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indians is false and part of a scam.
outputs.what_post_claims: A viral message claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians three months of free mobile recharge.
outputs.what_is_true: The Indian government has not announced any scheme for three months of free mobile recharge. Messages and videos promoting this offer are fake and part of a scam to trick people into clicking malicious links.
evidence_against: Akashvani News reported that the government debunked a video claiming PM Modi announced free three-month recharge, stating it's fake and AI-generated.
BOOM Live rated the claim as false, stating that the video of PM Modi announcing free recharge is edited.
Vishvas News rated as false the claim that PM Modi is giving free mobile recharge under various schemes.
outputs.sources_spoken: Akashvani News, BOOM Live, and Vishvas News
outputs.audio_script: A message circulating online claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians three months of free mobile recharge. This claim is a scam. The Indian government has not announced any such scheme for free mobile recharge. Messages and videos promoting this offer are fake and are designed to trick people into clicking on malicious links. We are very sure about this information. This comes from reports by Akashvani News, BOOM Live, and Vishvas News, which have all debunked this false claim.
card_lines: SCAM: PM Modi is not giving free mobile recharge
The claim of free mobile recharge is false.
It is a scam to get you to click on malicious links.
Akashvani News, BOOM Live, and Vishvas News confirm this.
